result: Enhanced NL-to-Workflow backend with 6 major features
features_added: DAG Cycle Detection - DFS-based algorithm to detect cycles in workflow graphs with cycle path reporting
Workflow Cost Estimation - Estimates cost based on node types, LLM model, and complexity multiplier
Enhanced Intent Detection with Subtypes - Added workflow subtype detection (qa_bot, data_processing, translation, moderation, article_generation, customer_service, generic) and retry intent detection
Better Prompt with Few-Shot Examples - Expanded from 2 to 5 diverse examples covering sequential, conditional, API call, parallel, and loop patterns
Node Position Auto-Layout - Integrated calculate_node_positions() into _validate_workflow() for auto-positioning
Workflow Name Auto-generation - Added _generate_workflow_name() to extract key nouns/verbs from description
summary: Implemented all 6 requested enhancements to the NL-to-Workflow backend: (1) DAG cycle detection using DFS algorithm with cycle path reporting, (2) workflow cost estimation based on node types and complexity, (3) enhanced intent detection with 7 workflow subtypes and retry detection, (4) expanded prompt with 5 diverse workflow examples covering sequential/conditional/API/parallel/loop patterns, (5) auto-layout integration for node positioning, and (6) auto-generation of workflow names from descriptions. The analyze_intent() function now returns a dict with intent, subtype, and is_retry fields for richer context.
